name: Vinegar
aliases: vinegar, fermentation vinegar, wine vinegar, cider vinegar, spirit vinegar, vinagre, vinaigre, distilled vinegar, malt vinegar, rice vinegar, balsamic vinegar
what_is: An acidic liquid produced by the two-step fermentation of ethanol by acetic acid bacteria.
why_botia: It flags it to verify its origin and ensure that any residual alcohol from the fermentation process is within safe halal limits.
can_1: Detect the word 'vinegar' and its common language translations on a food label.
can_2: Verify if it is derived from a single basic product as allowed under simplified labeling regulations.
cannot_1: Determine the exact percentage of residual ethyl alcohol remaining in the vinegar.
cannot_2: Confirm if synthetic acetic acid was added to dilute the fermentation product.

sources.label: Codex General Guidelines for Use of the Term Halal (CAC/GL 24-1997)
